title: Sample: release decisions
context_md: Branch `release/2.4` is green on CI. Three calls needed before tagging.

decisions.question: Deploy strategy for 2.4?
decisions.context_md:
| Strategy | Rollback | Infra cost | Blast radius |
|---|---|---|---|
| Blue-green | instant flip | 2x fleet | zero |
| Rolling | redeploy previous | none | partial |
| Canary | instant route-away | +1 node | 5% traffic |

options.label: Blue-green
options.description: Full parallel fleet, instant cutover and rollback

options.label: Rolling
options.description: In-place, no extra infra, slower rollback

options.label: Canary 5%
options.description: Route 5% for an hour, then promote

options.label: Dark mode
options.description: Ready, marketing wants it in the announcement

decisions.question: Tag this build as stable?
decisions.label: Tag as stable
decisions.context_md: Stable tags are what the auto-updater offers to clients. The last stable was 2.3.7.
